title: Initial REST catalog spec changes needed for Iceberg V4
summary: Dhruv Arya listed the first REST spec changes V4 needs: a root-manifest in Snapshot as an alternative to manifest-list, a table-location in load, commit and unregister responses to allow relative paths, and an optional metadata-location in CommitTableResponse. Because manifest-list and metadata-location are required today, he offered two approaches: duplicating models and endpoints as v2 (PR #17543), or relaxing the required fields in place (PR #17642), which he preferred. Daniel Weeks and Amogh Jahagirdar favoured the smaller model change combined with a new v2 loadTable endpoint that all V4 tables must be loaded through, since clients cannot be relied on to check format-version before failing on a missing field. Yufei Gu agreed that v1 loadTable must not return V4 metadata and suggested an error response instead. In November Daniel Weeks created a rest-v4-changes branch to collect the OpenAPI changes. No vote was held in the thread.

positions.stance: Leans toward making manifest-list and metadata-location optional in place rather than duplicating models and endpoints as v2.
Prefers the second approach, but with a v2 loadTable endpoint required for all V4 tables; only load table needs a version bump.
Agrees with a v2 load endpoint serving v1-v4 tables, and thinks the V4 table spec should be voted before the v2 REST spec.
Since format-version is required in TableMetadata, a client should be able to identify the version before interpreting the rest of the metadata.
Field processing order cannot be guaranteed, so an older client may fail on a missing required location before it can check the version.
The v1 loadTable endpoint must not return V4 metadata and should return a documented error; suggested collecting other v2 requirements such as partial metadata loading.
An error response for V4 tables on v1 loadTable is right, but is hesitant to take on partial metadata loading as part of the v2 endpoint.

outcome.note: Participants converged on in-place model changes plus a v2 loadTable endpoint for V4 tables. A rest-v4-changes branch was created to collect the spec changes, with PR #17642 open for feedback.

why_it_matters: It introduces the first versioned (v2) REST endpoint, and catalogs and clients will need it to load V4 tables.
